d:
Patna men anant sinh aur unke parivar ki mushkilen barhti najar aa rahi hain. mokama ke bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ki vidhayki par sankat ke bich unki patni nilam devi se bhi sarkari pad aur rajyamantri ka darja vapas le liya gaya hai. ek taraph anant sinh par rajnitik aur kanuni karravaee ka dabav hai, to dusri taraph nilam devi ko bhi sarkari jimmedariyon se hataya gaya hai. aakhir anant sinh aur nilam devi par hue is dohre ekshan ke pichhe kya hai pura mamla? janie is riport men.
